title: a16z Podcast: The $200 PC in the Enterprise

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: What capabilities do enterprise companies really want from their computers?
reader_summary.overview: What capabilities do enterprise companies really want from their computers? Twenty years ago, those capabilities might've been bundled into a mainframe. Ten years ago, it might've been the PC. Today, as more and more businesses rely on devices that need only browsers/ internet connectivity.

key_points.text: Today, as more and more businesses rely on devices that need only browsers/ internet connectivity.
In this hallway-style episode of the a16z Podcast, Benedict Evans and Steven Sinofsky discuss how tech devices evolve for the enterprise -- and more broadly.
